notes: Identity verified from the repository cover, article title page and publication details: Jessica J. Staniland and Mitchell K. Byrne; The Effects of a Multi-Component Higher-Functioning Autism Anti-Stigma Program on Adolescent Boys; 2013, Journal of Autism and Developmental Disorders 43(12), 2816–2829. The cache provenance header supplies DOI 10.1007/s10803-013-1829-4, matching the reference. This is a primary author-manuscript text with methods, results, discussion, references, appendix and Table 1, rather than an abstract-only web excerpt. No PDF was supplied. The supplied locator is p. 6 with a description jointly naming knowledge, attitudes and behavioural intentions, without specifying outcome, time contrast, main effect, interaction or follow-up test. In this supplied author manuscript, pp.6–7 are literature review/present-study material and p.8 is Participants/Procedure; the intervention results are on pp.13–15. Published-page correspondence is not established. Multiple candidate tests remain; no target is assigned by audit ID order or numerical matching. Candidate same-test F/p pairs (author manuscript pp. 13–14): knowledge time F(2, 410)=48.80, p<.001; condition F(2, 205)=34.62, p<.001; interaction F(4, 410)=42.51, p<.001. Attitudes time F(2, 392)=4.34, p=.01; condition F(2, 196)=.24, p=.79; interaction F(4, 392)=3.15, p=.01. Behavioural intentions time F(2,402)=1.51, p=.22; condition F(2,201)=.99, p=.37; interaction F(4, 402)=.62, p=.65. Knowledge and attitudes also have between-condition follow-ups, within-condition repeated-measures tests and paired pre/post/follow-up tests; manipulation checks are separate tests on p.12 and online activity analyses are separate on p.15. Printed F and t statistics are available, but none is selected without an identified row-specific outcome and contrast. The manuscript p.8 gives 395 participants allocated to intervention n=46, no-intervention peer n=66, and no-intervention non-peer n=283, and reports two intervention dropouts after session one. Table 1 (p.27) repeats group Ns 46, 66, 283 for descriptive scores. These are not established as complete-case analytic Ns for the critical models; different tests have different printed degrees of freedom. No N is inferred from df, and no final-group sum is claimed. Only original n, es and p are assigned; replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
